questions.q: Which energy system uses phosphocreatine and makes no lactic acid?
questions.why: The ATP-PC system uses stored phosphocreatine without oxygen and produces no lactic acid.

questions.q: What are the by-products of the aerobic system?
questions.why: Glucose and oxygen produce ATP, carbon dioxide and water.

questions.q: Which is a long-term effect of regular aerobic training?
questions.why: Stroke volume rises so fewer beats are needed at rest.

questions.q: Explain what EPOC is and why it is higher after a sprint than after a gentle jog.
questions.model: EPOC is the extra oxygen taken in after exercise to restore the body to its resting state. After a sprint, more anaerobic work was done, so there is more lactic acid to remove and more ATP/PC to restore.
points: EPOC = extra oxygen after exercise to recover
greater anaerobic work / more lactic acid to remove after sprint
